open_questions: Is the checkpoint-gate waiver recorded anywhere the hooks or a reviewer can read (owner message, committed note)? Not in the bundle.

The A/A floor at p=1009 comes from one failed-attempt retry; whether a retry should count in the form-spread floor is a protocol design question, answerable only in a new preregistered study, not by reanalysis of this one.
Report text 'three instances at p=4099 have two decompositions' disagrees with rows (one instance, p4099-i8); should be corrected.
Cell counts are nearly identical across primes and instances (generic structure); whether the 9.1x gap persists at n=m=4 or for other msolve versions is untested.

recommendation.reason: Hashes, adherence, freeze-before-data, recompute and a nonce-chosen replay all agree with the export and the verdicts follow the frozen rule (C-mono supported_within_scope, C-tree inconclusive). Remaining defects are the unverifiable checkpoint-gate waiver and a one-instance miscount in the report. A preregistered replicate at a new prime/instance set, with the retry-in-floor question settled in advance, would settle C-tree.
